nodes.name: StorageUsageBar.tsx
nodes.summary: React component rendering a segmented bar chart of offline/PWA storage usage by category, with hover tooltips and an optional legend, backed by the storageManager service.

nodes.name: usePdfImportPolling.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that polls the PDF import status endpoint at an interval until the import reaches a terminal state or times out.

nodes.name: useSyncConflicts.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing offline-sync conflict state, persisting unresolved and resolved conflicts to localStorage and exposing add/resolve/dismiss actions for the conflict resolution UI.

nodes.name: ChecklistDetailPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page component for viewing and editing a single checklist, including adding/checking/removing items and managing default checklist items.

nodes.name: ChecklistsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page component listing a user's checklists (global and per-trip), supporting creation, deletion, and navigation to checklist detail views.

nodes.name: TripSeriesListPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page component listing a user's trip series (grouped multi-trip journeys) with creation via modal and computed date ranges per series.

nodes.name: TripSeriesPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page component for a single trip series showing its member trips, allowing trips to be added, removed, and reordered within the series.

nodes.name: airport.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for searching airports by IATA/ICAO code or name, used to power airport autocomplete inputs.

nodes.name: checklist.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for CRUD operations on checklists and checklist items, including default-checklist management (initialize, remove, restore, auto-check from trip data).

nodes.name: languagePhrase.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for the trip language phrasebook feature: listing available languages/phrases/categories and managing which languages are associated with a trip.

nodes.name: packingSuggestion.service.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal API client service that fetches weather-based packing suggestions for a trip.

nodes.name: pdfImport.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for the AI-powered PDF import feature: uploading PDFs, polling import status, and reviewing/accepting/rejecting AI-extracted pending entities.

nodes.name: storageManager.service.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side offline storage manager for the PWA: measures Cache Storage and IndexedDB usage, computes a category breakdown, lists cached trips, and clears stale or per-trip offline data, exposed as a default-exported singleton.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the browser Cache Storage and IndexedDB APIs directly (via idb-style promise wrapping) rather than a dedicated storage library; most functions are aggregated into a single default-exported object rather than named exports.

nodes.name: travelDocument.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for managing travel documents (passports, visas, etc.) and their expiration alerts, exported as a plain singleton object.

nodes.name: tripSeries.service.ts
nodes.summary: API client service for CRUD on trip series and for adding, removing, and reordering trips within a series.

nodes.name: checklist.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for checklists and checklist items, including DTOs for create/update operations and stats/progress fields.

nodes.name: languagePhrase.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for language phrases and trip-language associations, plus a CATEGORY_INFO lookup used by the phrasebook UI.

nodes.name: packingSuggestion.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for weather-based packing suggestions, including category/priority unions and the weather-conditions summary used to generate them.

nodes.name: pdfImport.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for PDF import records and AI-extracted pending entities, including their status/type unions.

nodes.name: sync.types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions and helper functions for the offline-sync conflict resolution UI: entity/resolution labels and icons, field-level diffing, value formatting, and merged-data construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines pure type declarations with a substantial set of exported helper functions (field diffing, formatting, merge logic), unusual for a *.types.ts file.

nodes.name: travelDocument.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for travel documents and document alerts, plus helper functions computing expiration status styling/labels and a document-type icon.

nodes.name: tripSeries.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interfaces for trip series and their member trips, plus create/update input DTOs.

nodes.name: StorageUsageBar
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that loads storage usage/breakdown data on mount, renders a segmented usage bar with per-category hover tooltips, and optionally a legend.

nodes.name: usePdfImportPolling
nodes.summary: Hook that runs a TanStack Query polling loop against pdfImportService.getPdfImportById, stopping once the import reaches a terminal status or a timeout elapses.

nodes.name: useSyncConflicts
nodes.summary: Hook exposing conflict list state and add/resolve/dismiss/clear-history actions, persisting active and resolved conflicts to localStorage across sessions.

nodes.name: ChecklistDetailPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page rendering a single checklist's items with toggling, adding, editing, and deleting, plus default-checklist restore/remove controls.

nodes.name: ChecklistsPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page listing all checklists for the user, grouped by trip, with create/delete actions and empty-state handling.

nodes.name: getSeriesDateRange
nodes.summary: Helper that derives the earliest start date and latest end date across a trip series' member trips for display in the list.

nodes.name: TripSeriesListPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page listing the user's trip series with a modal for creating new series and empty-state handling.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Local helper formatting an ISO date string for display on the trip series page.

nodes.name: getStatusColor
nodes.summary: Local helper mapping a trip status value to a Tailwind color class for the trip-series trip list.

nodes.name: TripSeriesPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page for a single trip series, showing member trips with add/remove/reorder actions and per-trip status/date display.

nodes.name: AirportService
nodes.summary: Service class with a single searchAirports method querying the backend airport-search endpoint, instantiated and default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: ChecklistService
nodes.summary: Service class wrapping all checklist and checklist-item CRUD endpoints plus default-checklist management (initialize, restore, remove, auto-check), default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: LanguagePhraseService
nodes.summary: Service class wrapping phrasebook endpoints (languages, phrases, categories) and trip-language association management, default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: PackingSuggestionService
nodes.summary: Minimal service class with a single getSuggestions method fetching weather-based packing suggestions, default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: PdfImportService
nodes.summary: Service class wrapping the PDF-upload, import-status, and pending-entity review (accept/reject/update/reparse) endpoints, default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: TripSeriesService
nodes.summary: Service class wrapping trip-series CRUD plus add/remove/reorder-trip endpoints, default-exported as a singleton.

nodes.name: formatBytes
nodes.summary: Named-exported helper formatting a byte count into a human-readable string (KB/MB/GB).

nodes.name: getCacheSize
nodes.summary: Computes the total byte size of a named Cache Storage cache by summing its response body sizes.

nodes.name: getIndexedDBStoreSize
nodes.summary: Estimates the byte size of an IndexedDB object store by iterating its records and summing serialized sizes.

nodes.name: openDatabase
nodes.summary: Opens (or creates) the app's IndexedDB database, wrapped in a Promise for use by the other storage-measurement functions.

nodes.name: getStorageUsage
nodes.summary: Aggregates total and per-source (Cache Storage vs IndexedDB) storage usage using the Storage Manager API where available.

nodes.name: getStorageBreakdown
nodes.summary: Computes a per-category (photos, trips, documents, etc.) breakdown of offline storage usage across caches and IndexedDB stores, consumed by StorageUsageBar.

nodes.name: getCachedTrips
nodes.summary: Lists trips currently cached for offline access along with metadata such as cached size and last-updated timestamp.

nodes.name: clearCategory
nodes.summary: Clears all cached data belonging to a single storage category (e.g. photos, documents) across relevant caches and IndexedDB stores.

nodes.name: clearAllOfflineData
nodes.summary: Clears every offline cache and IndexedDB store used by the PWA, effectively resetting local storage.

nodes.name: clearOldData
nodes.summary: Removes cached data older than a given age threshold across storage sources, supporting the auto-cleanup feature.

nodes.name: getOldestData
nodes.summary: Returns the oldest cached items up to a limit, used to preview what would be removed by cleanup operations.

nodes.name: getAutoCleanupSettings
nodes.summary: Reads the user's auto-cleanup preferences (enabled flag, max age) from localStorage with defaults.

nodes.name: clearTripData
nodes.summary: Clears all cached data (photos, details, documents) associated with a single trip ID from offline storage.

nodes.name: getFieldLabel
nodes.summary: Exported helper returning a human-readable label for an entity field name, used by the conflict-diff UI.

nodes.name: formatFieldName
nodes.summary: Exported helper converting a camelCase field name into a display-friendly label when no explicit FIELD_LABELS entry exists.

nodes.name: formatValueForDisplay
nodes.summary: Exported helper formatting a conflict field's raw value (dates, booleans, nulls, objects) into a readable string for the diff view.

nodes.name: valuesAreDifferent
nodes.summary: Exported helper performing a value-aware equality check (handling nulls and type coercion) to decide whether two conflicting field values actually differ.

nodes.name: getFieldDiffs
nodes.summary: Exported helper that compares local and server versions of an entity and returns the list of fields that differ, excluding fields marked in EXCLUDED_DIFF_FIELDS.

nodes.name: createMergedData
nodes.summary: Exported helper that builds a merged entity object from local and server versions based on per-field resolution choices.

nodes.name: getExpirationStatusClasses
nodes.summary: Exported helper mapping a travel document's expiration status to Tailwind CSS classes for alert styling.

nodes.name: getExpirationStatusLabel
nodes.summary: Exported helper producing a human-readable label describing a travel document's expiration status (e.g. days remaining, expired).

nodes.name: getDocumentTypeIcon
nodes.summary: Exported helper returning an emoji/icon representing a travel document type (passport, visa, etc.).
